'''Neil Goodacre Agents In The Desert''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Neil Goodacre]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds122.htm Agents In The Desert], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001028162121/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds122.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
